title: Lucia Read the Key Upside Down
hook: Jason opened locker sixty-nine. Empty. Footsteps hammered behind the showers. Their stolen diamonds were missing.
script: Jason opened locker sixty-nine. Empty. Footsteps hammered behind the showers. Their stolen diamonds were missing. The Fixer had handed them one key, then vanished. Lucia studied the numbers beneath a swinging light. A line sat above them. She turned the tag. Ninety-six. Jason had followed it upside down. They reached the other aisle. A cleaning cart blocked the door, and the key refused to turn. Jason pulled harder. Lucia stopped him. The cart wheel was pressing the locker door against its latch. She kicked the cart clear. The lock turned. Inside sat their blue pouch, still sealed with red thread. They slipped through the shower exit as the Fixer reached the wrong aisle, following their open locker. On the seawall, Jason counted every diamond. Lucia hung the key upright around his neck. Numbers mattered tonight.

story_audit.goal: Recover their diamond stash from the marina locker before the Fixer catches them.
story_audit.stakes: Losing the score or being cornered in the locker aisles.
story_audit.obstacle: Inverted tag number and a door jammed by a cleaning cart.
story_audit.planted_clue: A small engraving line fixes the physical tag orientation; cart pressure is shown before the key resists.
story_audit.payoff: The right locker holds every diamond and the first open wrong locker misdirects the Fixer long enough to escape.
story_audit.causal_check: The key never changes engraving and opens only96. Cart pressure explains the binding latch. Separate aisles and rear shower exit are established before the escape.
